study_unit: one same-race archived official racelist+beforeinfo+odds120 triple with 12/12 checks, separately reverified original bytes

encoding.normal_decimal: preserve official lexical string and encode decimal seconds after start as a nonnegative decimal string
encoding.F_decimal: F.03 is preserved as original label and encoded as -0.03 second, with separate F classification; never treat F as a main-race disqualification
encoding.L_decimal: retain raw L label and class; signed seconds is null, never silently assume a numeric seconds offset
encoding.F_zero: F.00 is retained as F class and signed decimal string -0.00, not merged into ordinary 0.00
encoding.other_missing_or_ambiguous: reject; no imputation or default numeric ST
encoding.exhibition_vs_main: exhibition entry and ST are never automatically final entry or a completed main-race result

prospective_sample_selection: future official source receipt from the separate collection workstream only; no retroactive source first-remote claims, no substitution of missing races, never treat read-only replay as first observed live data
future_forecast_gate: A distinct, future-only preregistered F-aware FOUR-MODE model with fully pinned math, conditional heads, independent same-race candidate first remote receipt before T-12, outcome-last scorer and new pilot+confirmation cohorts is required BEFORE any accuracy claim or live selector use.
scope: feature_encoding ONLY; no model coefficients, odds-based ticket reordering, hypothetical winner, result/payout loader, live forecast, Cron, publisher or production change
